name: How long does it take to install new energy-efficient windows?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new energy-efficient windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for new energy-efficient windows depends on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the installation. For a typical residential project, installation can range from a few days to over a week. We work to minimize disruption and maintain a clean workspace throughout the process. During our initial consultation in areas like San Leandro or Union City, we'll provide a more precise timeline based on your home's specific requirements and our project schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by the number and size of windows, typically ranging from a few days to over a week for a residential project.
